Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly by following the example there.

Syntax to use for all sections:
[[ ]] for variables (A, B)
{{ }} for constants (0, 1)
<< >> for bold (Line 1, Line 2)

Goal
* Please replace both instances of "Display" with "Output".

* Please remove "Remember" and the three points below it, as they're repetitive.

Input
* For simplicity, please replace the entire section with the following:

<<Line 1>>: A binary number [[A]].
<<Line 2>>: A binary number [[B]].

Output
* Please remove "Print two lines:".

* Please change "First line" to "<<Line 1>>".

* Please change "Second line" to "<<Line 2>>".

* Please add "Unnecessary leading zeros should be fully removed." to the end of the first description.

Constraints
* Please add "in [[A]] and [[B]]" to the end of the 3rd constraint.

* Please insert the following as the 2nd constraint:
Length of [[A]] = Length of [[B]]

Stub generator
* Please change both instances of 100 to 16.

Cases
* Each test and its corresponding validator should cover the same scenario while using slightly different inputs and outputs. Please revise all validators accordingly.

For example, Validator 2 should also cover the scenario where the output is longer than both [[A]] and [[B]]. Validator 3 should also cover the scenario where both [[A]] and [[B]] consist entirely of zeros.

* Please add a new pair of cases covering the scenario where [[A]] and [[B]] contain ones and many leading zeros, resulting in a binary sum that's shorter than both [[A]] and [[B]].

* Please add a new pair of cases covering a comprehensive scenario in which all possible combinations of digits at the same position in [[A]] and [[B]] are represented (0 + 0, 0 + 1, 1 + 0 and 1 + 1), with both [[A]] and [[B]] containing more than 10 digits.

Thanks.
